test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Electrician) Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: When drawing a curved line of a specific length in an engineering drawing, which tool is most appropriate for ensuring accuracy?
solution: When drawing a curved line of a specific length and smooth shape in engineering drawing, accuracy and smoothness are essential. • A French curve is a drafting tool specifically designed to draw smooth, irregular curves accurately. • It allows the drafter to match and trace the required curve shape precisely.
